name: Teresa
source:
This sensual, clever librarian has … a fixation with occultism and an unearthly power. Trevor may be ready to fall in love with her brains, wit, and other … assets; but will her deadly secrets of terror rip you apart and devour you?

[b]LIKES[/b]: intellect and good manners
[b]HATES[/b]: wasting her time, people without imagination
[b]DREAMS ABOUT[/b]: being someone important, changing the world
[b]SEXUAL PARTNERS[/b]: no more than 6
